title: Start a Wooden Furniture Factory in Pakistan: Real Cost
description:
Every wedding in Pakistan needs a bed set, a sofa and a dining table. We explain where to set up, what a small unit makes, how timber becomes furniture, the machines and full cost from a Government of Pakistan (SMEDA) study, how fast wood prices have risen, and the busy season.
